design_specificity: Strongly specific to Yeonseok and Lisbeth. The portraits, exact countries/cities, InterPals/awkwardness/twelve-hour story, thirteen-hour clock, playful room reactions and letter/signature/rose ending cannot be transferred to an unrelated product unchanged. Its weakness is continuity and composition, not generic content.

heuristics.name: Visibility of System Status
heuristics.reason: Chosen gallery, time preview, signature and local feedback states remain immediate and legible. The long cinematic entry still gives little intermediate orientation.

heuristics.name: Match Between System and Real World
heuristics.reason: The language is specifically for this couple: InterPals, the awkward beginning, twelve continuous hours, Gwangju/Santo Domingo, thirteen hours, family domino play and the personal letter. The relationship date stays separate from first-contact copy.

heuristics.name: User Control and Freedom
heuristics.reason: Direct games/letter navigation, optional signing, shared-panel Escape, fold/reread and actual game entry all worked again in both languages.

heuristics.name: Consistency and Standards
heuristics.reason: Now one opaque face/desk composition, deterministic reverse scroll, consistent control state and intentional bilingual wrapping. The .24 pose cut and .39 arched reveal remain visible editorial changes, so this is not seamless character continuity.

heuristics.name: Error Prevention
heuristics.reason: Empty feedback and invalid signature are prevented; meaningful drawn stroke plus explicit commit remain. No additional point for merely preserving these guards.

heuristics.name: Recognition Rather Than Recall
heuristics.reason: Larger inactive sculptures are easier to recognize and all eight labels remain visible. The eight-way selection still demands scanning; no perfect-recognition claim.

heuristics.name: Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
heuristics.reason: Native games navigation honors the80px header margin; arrow-key selection, real Jaipur CTA, language persistence and reread work. No power-user dashboard requirements imposed.

heuristics.name: Aesthetic and Minimalist Design
heuristics.reason: Gallery peers, two-language line breaks, tighter InterPals and the wide time composition improve hierarchy/rhythm. Clean masked faces and desk edges remove double exposure. Thin thread, sealed-envelope hold and visible pose/reveal cuts remain.

heuristics.name: Error Recovery
heuristics.reason: Solo continuation/Escape and normal local feedback still recover correctly. Parent technical reviewer additionally verified exact SDK storage-key throw shows localized App recovery before feedback import, with home/games/retry and no page errors; this is attributed, not a new A injection test.

heuristics.name: Help and Documentation
heuristics.reason: Clock/day offset, signing/text alternative, local-only save and game entry retain contextual help. Optional letter entry labels still require interpretation.

applicability: All ten apply to the reviewed mixed surface: game selection, signature and feedback provide real efficiency, prevention, recovery and contextual-help tasks. No irrelevant dashboard/bulk-action requirements were imposed.

emotional_journey.handoff: Seated couple now remains present and opaque; no ghosting or holes. The explicit pose cut and curved opening read as editing rather than seamless travel.

emotional_journey.peak_end: Actual letter→real drawn optional pact→received rose→reread remains the emotional peak, successful in both languages.
emotional_journey.recommendation: Preserve the completed ending; any next work should refine editorial continuity and held-screen density.

priority_issues.title: The pose cut and arched room reveal are still visible editorial changes
priority_issues.impact: Clear and stable, but the couple changes pose instantly and the room arrives through a conspicuous curved aperture. It does not read as one seamless camera trip.
priority_issues.fix: Treat the .24 handoff as an authored editorial cut and register the couple framing around it; refine the aperture geometry to the existing scene architecture if another art pass is authorized. Preserve clean opaque original faces, desk continuity and original B. Do not reinstate face crossfades or invent 3D bodies.

priority_issues.title: The thread and sealed-envelope stretches remain materially thin
priority_issues.impact: The middle is tighter and more varied, but some held screens still feel like type on a field or the same unopened artifact repeated.
priority_issues.fix: Enlarge/recompose the existing truthful thread or shorten its inactive spacing; reduce sealed-state hold using current envelope/letter states. Keep the initial-rudeness and twelve-hour distinctions and the actual single letter; add no fake chat.

priority_issues.title: Small supporting copy and letter entry labels need another clarity pass
priority_issues.impact: The principal actions are clear, but muted small labels and the distinction among opening, direct reading and synchronized opening rely on interpretation.
priority_issues.fix: Increase only meaningful small labels and clarify the existing three entry purposes without adding new actions. Preserve browser-local/shared-service truth.
